carnivore.title: 30 Day Carnivore Meal Plan | Carnivore Diet Menu Printable | Macros + Weekly Grocery Lists | Beginner Meat Based Plan | Instant Download
carnivore.description:
Thirty days of carnivore, planned down to the last strip of bacon. The steaks have never been higher.

Here's what's inside:
- 30 daily menus (breakfast, lunch, dinner) built for real kitchens, not cooking shows
- Computed macros for every single day: protein, fat, and calories at a glance
- 4 weekly grocery lists so you shop once a week and you're done
- Our free 30-day tracker PDF so you can log how you actually feel and what actually changes

One thing that makes this plan different: it's satiety-based, not calorie-restricted. We don't hand you a number and tell you to stay under it. We set your protein, keep fat generous, and let your own hunger signals do the regulating. That's how carnivore is supposed to work, and it's why people stick with it.

Who it's for: beginners who want the "what do I eat" question answered for a full month, and returners who fell off and want structure back. If you're brand new, the first week is deliberately simple.

Honest note: this is an instant digital download, a printable PDF. Nothing ships to your door except the confidence of a person who knows what dinner is. Print the whole thing or just the weekly lists.

I'm not a doctor, and this plan is education, not medical advice. If you take medications or have a diagnosed condition, talk to your doctor before changing how you eat.

Thirty days, one grocery list a week, no math at the dinner table. Let's go.

keto.title: 28 Day Keto Meal Plan 1500 Calorie | 4 Week Keto Menu with Grocery Lists | Under 25g Net Carbs | Printable PDF | Instant Download
keto.description:
Four weeks of keto where the only thing you have to figure out is which pan to use.

Here's what's inside:
- 28 daily menus (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack), each day built around 1500 calories
- Net carbs under 25g every single day, already counted for you
- Macros listed per day so you can see calories, carbs, protein, and fat at a glance
- 4 weekly grocery lists, one shop per week and you're covered

Who it's for: anyone who wants keto with structure. If you've ever ended a keto attempt because "I ran out of ideas by day nine," this is the fix. It's also a good fit if you like a calorie framework and don't want to track everything in an app for a month.

The meals are normal food. Eggs, meat, fish, cheese, vegetables, good fats. Nothing that requires a specialty store or a food processor with a personality.

Honest note: this is an instant digital download, a printable PDF you print at home. No physical product ships. Print all of it, or just tape the weekly grocery list to the fridge like the rest of us.

I'm not a doctor. A 1500-calorie target fits many people, but not everyone, and if you take medications (especially for blood sugar or blood pressure) talk to your doctor before starting keto.

One month, planned start to finish. All you have to do is eat.

lowcarb.title: 28 Day Low Carb Meal Plan 1500 Calorie | 4 Week Menu with Grocery Lists | Berries Yogurt Whole Foods | Printable PDF Instant Download
lowcarb.description:
Low carb without the "I can never eat fruit again" energy. Four weeks, planned.

Here's what's inside:
- 28 daily menus (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack) built around 1500 calories a day
- A gentler carb ceiling than keto, so berries, yogurt, quinoa, and lentils are included
- Computed macros for every day: calories, carbs, protein, fat
- 4 weekly grocery lists so shopping takes one trip a week

Who it's for: people who want the steadier energy and easier portions of lower-carb eating, but who know themselves well enough to know strict keto isn't their long game. It's also a comfortable landing spot if keto felt too tight, or if you're easing a family into eating this way and need meals normal humans will accept.

Everything is whole food you can get at a regular grocery store. No powders, no products with numbers in the name.

Honest note: this is an instant digital download, a printable PDF. You print it at home, nothing ships. The weekly grocery lists print nicely on their own if that's all you want on paper.

I'm not a doctor, and a 1500-calorie framework won't fit every body. If you have a diagnosed condition or take medications that interact with diet, loop in your doctor first.

A month of lower-carb meals you'd actually choose. That's the whole pitch.

lion.title: Lion Diet 30 Day Protocol | Elimination Diet Meal Plan + Reintroduction Guide | Symptom Journal Pages | Beef Salt Water | Printable PDF
lion.description:
Beef, salt, water, and a plan for what comes after. This is the lion diet done with structure instead of vibes.

Here's what's inside:
- The complete 30-day beef, salt, and water elimination protocol, laid out day by day
- A structured reintroduction schedule: one food at a time, 3-day observation windows, in a deliberate order
- A 30-day symptom journal covering digestion, skin, joints, sleep, energy, and mood
- Practical guidance on cuts, salting, batch cooking, and getting through the hard days

Who it's for: people troubleshooting stubborn symptoms who want to run a real elimination experiment, not just wing it and hope. The journal pages are the heart of this. An elimination diet without records is just a very repetitive month.

Who it's NOT for: anyone looking for a forever diet or a quick weight loss trick. This is a diagnostic tool with an exit plan built in, and the exit plan is half the product.

Honest note: this is an instant digital download, a printable PDF. Print the journal pages as many times as you need.

Please hear this part clearly: I'm not a doctor, and an elimination protocol this strict deserves medical oversight. If you take medications or have any diagnosed condition, work with your healthcare provider before starting, not after. That's not legal boilerplate. It's the actual right way to do this.

Thirty days of quiet, then careful answers.

pescatarian.title: Pescatarian Meal Plan 30 Day Low Carb | Seafood Diet Menu with Grocery Lists | Printable PDF | Fish Meal Plan | Instant Download
pescatarian.description:
Low carb, but make it seafood. Thirty days of menus for people whose protein has fins.

Here's what's inside:
- 30 daily menus (breakfast, lunch, dinner), seafood-forward and low carb throughout
- Computed macros for every day: protein, fat, net carbs, calories
- Weekly grocery lists, organized so the fish counter takes five minutes instead of fifteen
- A realistic mix of fresh, frozen, and canned, because nobody's buying fresh halibut on a Tuesday

Who it's for: pescatarians who want a low-carb structure, low-carbers who don't tolerate or don't love red meat, and anyone whose bloodwork or doctor keeps nudging them toward more omega-3s. The plan leans on salmon, shrimp, white fish, sardines, eggs, and vegetables, with enough variety that day 22 doesn't taste like day 3.

You don't need cooking skills beyond a pan and an oven. The fanciest technique in this plan is "don't overcook it."

Honest note: this is an instant digital download, a printable PDF you print at home. Nothing ships. Print the grocery lists separately if that's all you need on paper.

I'm not a doctor. This is education, not a prescription, and if you're pregnant, take medications, or have a condition affected by diet, check with your healthcare provider first, including on fish and mercury guidance.

A month of eating like the coastline. Your omega-3s will notice.

mediterranean.title: 7 Day Mediterranean Meal Plan with Grocery List | Whole Food Menu Printable | Easy Mediterranean Diet Plan PDF | Instant Download
mediterranean.description:
One week of Mediterranean eating, fully planned, with a single grocery list. For five bucks, the decisions are handled.

Here's what's inside:
- 7 daily menus: breakfast, lunch, dinner, and a snack for a full week
- One consolidated grocery list, organized by store section so you're in and out
- Whole foods only: fish, olive oil, vegetables, legumes, yogurt, whole grains
- Prep notes that turn a few dinners into next-day lunches automatically

Who it's for: anyone curious about Mediterranean eating who learns better by doing a week of it than by reading another article about it. It's also a nice reset week if your meals have drifted into beige territory, and an easy way to cook one pattern for a whole household without special-ordering anything.

The Mediterranean pattern is one of the most-studied ways of eating there is, and the reason it keeps showing up in the research is that people actually stay on it. It tastes like food you'd choose.

Honest note: this is an instant digital download, a small printable PDF. Nothing ships, and the grocery list prints on one page for the fridge.

I'm not a doctor, and one week of good eating is a starting point, not a treatment plan. If you manage a health condition through diet, your healthcare provider should stay in the loop.

Seven days, one shopping trip, dinner already decided. That's a good week.
